request: Create a customer orders dashboard filtered to France.
search_document:
User Request: Create a customer orders dashboard filtered to France.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Total Orders
Type: metric
Description: Total number of orders placed by customers in France
Title: Monthly Revenue
Type: chart
Description: Monthly revenue trend from orders in France
Title: Top Products
Type: table
Description: List of top-selling products in France
Title: Order Status Distribution
Type: pie_chart
Description: Distribution of order statuses for orders in France
Title: Customer Demographics
Type: bar_chart
Description: Demographics of customers placing orders in France
Title: Shipping Methods Used
Type: bar_chart
Description: Distribution of shipping methods used for orders in France

sql_queries.title: Total Orders
sql_queries.description: Total number of orders placed by customers in France
sql_queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalOrders FROM Orders JOIN Customers ON Orders.CustomerID = Customers.CustomerID WHERE Customers.Country = 'France';

sql_queries.title: Monthly Revenue
sql_queries.description: Monthly revenue trend from orders in France
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, SUM((OrderDetails.UnitPrice * OrderDetails.Quantity) * (1 - OrderDetails.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders JOIN Customers ON Orders.CustomerID = Customers.CustomerID JOIN 'Order Details' AS OrderDetails ON Orders.OrderID = OrderDetails.OrderID WHERE Customers.Country = 'France' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) ORDER BY Month;

sql_queries.title: Top Products
sql_queries.description: List of top-selling products in France
sql_queries.sql: SELECT Products.ProductName, SUM(OrderDetails.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM Orders JOIN Customers ON Orders.CustomerID = Customers.CustomerID JOIN 'Order Details' AS OrderDetails ON Orders.OrderID = OrderDetails.OrderID JOIN Products ON OrderDetails.ProductID = Products.ProductID WHERE Customers.Country = 'France' GROUP BY Products.ProductID ORDER BY TotalQuantity DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_queries.title: Order Status Distribution
sql_queries.description: Distribution of order statuses for orders in France
sql_queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ShippedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shipped' ELSE 'Pending' END AS OrderStatus, COUNT(*) AS Count FROM Orders JOIN Customers ON Orders.CustomerID = Customers.CustomerID WHERE Customers.Country = 'France' GROUP BY OrderStatus;

sql_queries.title: Customer Demographics
sql_queries.description: Demographics of customers placing orders in France
sql_queries.sql: SELECT CustomerDemographics.CustomerDesc, COUNT(*) AS Count FROM Orders JOIN Customers ON Orders.CustomerID = Customers.CustomerID JOIN CustomerCustomerDemo ON Customers.CustomerID = CustomerCustomerDemo.CustomerID JOIN CustomerDemographics ON CustomerCustomerDemo.CustomerTypeID = CustomerDemographics.CustomerTypeID WHERE Customers.Country = 'France' GROUP BY CustomerDemographics.CustomerDesc;

sql_queries.title: Shipping Methods Used
sql_queries.description: Distribution of shipping methods used for orders in France
sql_queries.sql: SELECT Shippers.CompanyName, COUNT(*) AS Count FROM Orders JOIN Customers ON Orders.CustomerID = Customers.CustomerID JOIN Shippers ON Orders.ShipVia = Shippers.ShipperID WHERE Customers.Country = 'France' GROUP BY Shippers.CompanyName;
